purpose: ONNX encoder parity vs NeMo encoder (numerical reference)
rootCause: Community ONNX encoder (codavidgarcia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b-onnx) produces outputs that are essentially uncorrelated with the NeMo reference encoder (cosine similarity 0.05 across the prompt_id sweep [0,1,100,101]). Out-of-range prompt_ids (999, -1, 127) give marginally better cosine sim (~0.43) but are not valid for inference.
nextAction: Export encoder ourselves from NeMo (tools/model-debugging/reference/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming/export_nemo_encoder.py) and re-run parity.
